correctness.rationale: The restriction-class structure reduces every basis partner to the displayed canonical Fourier block with one repeated column. On the \(m-2\) dimensional zero-sum subspace the Gram eigenvalue is exactly \(m\), and direct expansion of the complementary \(3\times3\) block gives the stated cubic. Its signs at \(0,m,2m\), positivity of the Gram matrix, and the sign of the derivative at the extreme simple roots prove the root locations and monotonic optimization. At \(t=4\) the cubic factors as \((\lambda-1)(\lambda-2m)^2\); for odd \(m\) the maximal root-of-unity chord gives the stated \(t_m\), and the perturbation equation yields the asymptotic. Independent direct Fourier-Gram determinant checks through \(m=12\) reproduced the factorization and even-modulus spectrum.
risks: For odd \(m\), the exact extrema are characterized as distinguished roots of a cubic rather than simplified radicals.
